0022600097.text: Both teams are 1-0 entering their second game of the season, with the Raptors (2nd in the Atlantic, 4th in the East) on the road against the Wizards (2nd in the Southeast, 5th in the East). Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (out, Achilles surgery) and Nate Bittle (out, foot), while Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (out, ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (out, knee) and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip). The Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 134-125 win in Washington on February 28, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
